rv.q: The production is polished yet neither deeply affecting nor all that funny, lacking the rhythm, tonal confidence and textural richness of a truly great account of Chekhov.
Lindsay Posner's production takes no chances but fails to capture the writing's quality of musical melancholy.

cn.t: A respectable but restrained production that lacks the passion and intensity needed for Chekhov's tragicomedy, featuring a star-studded cast but struggling to capture the play's oppressive atmosphere.
